For the first time, it is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. The Position The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums. Key Responsibilities Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament. Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project. Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management. Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project. Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites. Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites. Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.). Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. description: Join or sign in to find your next job Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical 1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client. Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services. The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met. This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role. Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind. The role entails Collaborate proactively with a distributed team Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them Review code produced by other engineers Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events What we are looking for in you You love technology and working with brilliant people You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree You have extensive experience with Python on Linux You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end-system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on premise clouds Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description: Overview Department: Technical & Infrastructure Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. The Position The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards. The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums. Key Responsibilities Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament. Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project. Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management. Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project. Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites. Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites. Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.). Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Somos a Rede Hospital Casa um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores. Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO que seja organizado, prestativo e que tenha uma comunicação assertiva em seus processos de trabalho. Suas principais atividades serão: Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador; Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores; Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes; Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho; Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA); Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar; Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador; Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI); Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros; Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente; Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes; Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios; Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios; Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis; Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados; Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes; Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas; Dar suporte às perícias judiciais, à Medicina do trabalho conforme a deliberação da Coordenação do SESMT; Acompanhar as atividades pela enfermagem, hotelaria, serviços de higiene e limpeza, nutrição, com objetivo de assegurar as normas legais internas em segurança do trabalho; Participar de reuniões sobre segurança no trabalho, fornecendo dados relativos ao assunto, apresentando sugestões e analisando a viabilidade de medidas de segurança propostas, para aperfeiçoar o sistema existente; Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática; Executar e apoiar outras tarefas para o desenvolvimento das atividades do Setor, inerentes à sua Função; Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management. Trata-se de um centro de reabilitação, modalidade reabilitação intelectual, com ações e serviços voltados para avaliar, desenvolver ou ampliar a capacidade funcional para o desenvolvimento pleno das crianças e adolescentes com deficiência intelectual, transtornos globais de desenvolvimento, transtorno do espectro autista, investindo em iniciativas que trabalhem potencialidades, talentos, habilidades e aptidões físicas, cognitivas, sensoriais, psicossociais, atitudinais, profissionais e artísticas, para a autonomia e participação cidadã em igualdade de condições e oportunidades com as demais pessoas. title: Recruiter BRA (Remote)
description: A Recruiter is responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent to meet an organization’s staffing needs, ensuring that each hire aligns with both the technical requirements and the cultural values of the company. This role involves proactively sourcing candidates through a variety of channels, including job boards, professional networks, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, industry events, and employee referrals. Once potential candidates are identified, the Recruiter screens applications, conducts initial assessments, and manages interview processes to evaluate skills, experience, and fit. They work closely with hiring managers to define job requirements, craft compelling job descriptions, and establish selection criteria that lead to strong matches. The role extends beyond simply filling positions—it also involves managing the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial contact to offer negotiation and onboarding. This includes coordinating interviews, providing feedback to candidates, ensuring timely communication, and guiding both candidates and hiring teams through each stage of the process. A strong focus on candidate experience is key, as positive interactions contribute to the employer’s brand and long-term talent pipeline. In many cases, Recruiters also track and analyze hiring metrics—such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness—to refine strategies and improve overall recruitment efficiency. They stay informed about labor market trends, competitive compensation data, and evolving recruitment technologies, adapting approaches to remain competitive in attracting top talent. To excel, a Recruiter must combine exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with strategic thinking, organization, and relationship-building capabilities. Their work plays a critical role in shaping the company’s workforce, influencing its ability to grow, innovate, and succeed. title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. Overview Job Duties We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling: Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture. Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments. Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps. What You’ll Do Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph. Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates. The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution. Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad. Qualifications The Technology Stack You Do Not Need To Be An Expert In Every Single Tool, But You Must Be Able To Discuss Technical Trade-offs Across The Entire Stack Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph. Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js. Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark. Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud Desired Profile The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query. The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures. Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security. Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams. Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development. Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading). Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes). Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD). Advanced English communication skills. Good To Have Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB). GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases. Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data. Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents). Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA). Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments. Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management. EEO Statement Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. description: Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. Suas principais atividades serão: Participar e dar continuidade às atividades determinadas pela Gerência, Coordenação e Supervisão de Enfermagem; Exercer a função assistencial, educativa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem; auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e os que dificultam o processo de enfermagem; Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar; Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente; Prestar assistência aos pacientes, atendendo suas necessidades básicas (higiene e conforto, apoio emocional), zelando pela sua segurança; Participar de reuniões com a Gerência, Coordenação e/ou Supervisão de Enfermagem quando solicitado; Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários ao ato anestésico-cirúrgico e materiais que necessitam de data em dia; Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da Comissão de Controle de Infecções Hospitalares (CCIH), de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP); Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado; Manter sua chefia direta informadas sobre intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma, quando necessário, as devidas providências; Responsabilizar-se por toda aparelhagem de sua sala operatória, zelando pelo seu uso adequadamente; Comunicar ao enfermeiro supervisor qualquer defeito ou anormalidades ocorridas com materiais e equipamentos em sala; Avaliar a necessidade de material permanente (Braçadeira de Pressão não invasiva - PNI, cabo de oxímetro e etc) e comunicar a sua chefia direta, para que seja providenciada a sua reposição; Avaliar a necessidade de material descartável de consumo (Campos de cobertura cirurgica (LPS), campos de mesa auxiliar e etc) providenciando a sua reposição; Realizar reposição dos impressos da sala cirúrgica; Usar adequadamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs), de acordo com ambiente e/ou tipo de trabalho realizado e a Norma Regulamentadora 32 (NR32); Preencher no primeiro horário do plantão o check list da sala de cirurgia repondo os materiais faltantes; Estar ciente das cirurgias marcadas para a sala sob sua responsabilidade; Prover materiais e equipamentos adequados para sala cirúrgica, de acordo com cada tipo de cirurgia e com as necessidades individuais do paciente de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) de preparo de sala operatória; Observar as condições de limpeza da sala cirúrgica no início do dia e se a mesma não estiver em condições satisfatórias, solicitar a equipe de higienização do plantão; Checar o funcionamento da régua de gases, aparelhos de anestesia, monitores multi parâmetros, iluminação da sala e focos. Qualquer defeito apresentado comunicar ao enfermeiro supervisor do plantão; Solicitar o paciente ao maqueiro, quando delegado pelo enfermeiro; Assegurar as conformidades quanto às metas planejadas pelo Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente (NSP); Identificar as não conformidades e comunicar o enfermeiro para realizar a Notificação do NSP; Realizar admissão do paciente no centro cirúrgico, quando delegado pelo enfermeiro, dando continuidade ao preenchimento de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Perioperatória (SAEP); Cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética da enfermagem. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. title: Promotor Social - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description: Promotor Social - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Nesse contexto, a AVSI Brasil será responsável pela operacionalização de um projeto em parceria com a Águas do Rio, concessionária de distribuição de água potável que atua no município do Rio de Janeiro e na Baixada Fluminense. O projeto visa promover atividades de mobilização social, organização comunitária e ações educativas, com o objetivo de engajar e integrar as comunidades atendidas. As atividades planejadas incluem ações de conscientização sobre as obras e iniciativas sociais do Rio, realizadas por meio de abordagens lúdicas, participativas e imersivas, voltadas para crianças, jovens e adultos. O objetivo é fortalecer o diálogo com as comunidades, promover a transparência, incentivar a participação social e consolidar uma relação de confiança entre a concessionária e a população local, contribuindo para a eficácia das ações e para o bem‑estar das comunidades envolvidas. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Promotor(a) Social será responsável por planejar, executar e mediar ações educativas e socioculturais na área do Projeto Água do Rio, trabalhando diretamente com as comunidades atendidas, com foco em experiências lúdicas, participativas e imersivas. Realizar o mapeamento dos atores públicos e privados nas áreas de implementação das atividades do projeto. Organizar atividades e eventos, incluindo agendas, articulação local e divulgação; Desenvolver espaços voltados para crianças, jovens e adultos, promovendo o envolvimento do público de forma acessível, inclusiva e participativa; Criar, adaptar e aplicar oficinas participativas, utilizando metodologias interativas e conteúdo alinhado aos temas do patrocinador, como saneamento básico, tratamento de água, saúde ambiental e sustentabilidade; Desenvolver dinâmicas educativas que estimulem a reflexão, o diálogo e a participação ativa do público, respeitando as especificidades de cada faixa etária; Atuar como mediador entre o conteúdo do projeto e a comunidade, facilitando a compreensão das mensagens-chave por meio de jogos, experiências, rodas de conversas e atividades práticas; Apoiar ações realizadas em espaços educativos, culturais ou comunitários, garantindo uma abordagem educativa, de apoio e alinhada aos objetivos institucionais do Projeto Água do Rio; Realizar pesquisas de satisfação com o público participante; Preparar e apresentar relatórios qualitativos das atividades e eventos realizados; Consolidar relatórios periódicos de acompanhamento das ações; Colaborar com a equipe técnica da organização, prestar suporte e registrar as experiências e atividades realizadas. title: Senior Network Engineer
description: When defining the purpose of a job it is helpful to consider questions like: In what way does it contribute to the value of company? What part of the organisation’s or team’s total purpose is accomplished by people in this job? What is the unique contribution of this job that distinguishes it from other jobs? PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a valuable team member on our Enterprise Network Operations team supporting SES’s Corporate and Commercial Aviation Networks and Security infrastructure. This individual will be part of a team responsible for the implementation and troubleshooting of SES’s growing network and datacenter presence around the world. You will lead and assist with various projects that will challenge your skills with routing, switching, security, VoIP, and multi-media services including inflight entertainment. This position will work with and manage vendor relations and could have a voice in the purchase/quote process, as our business continues to expand. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses deep troubleshooting skills, and understands the delicate balance between network uptime and security compliance. Troubleshoot and resolve network issues involving Intelsat switches, routers, circuits, etc. Troubleshoot issues with our Palo Alto and Juniper firewall platform as well as implement policy rule changes to facilitate new services and connectivity. Document changes to all SES infrastructure to include Visio diagrams, spreadsheets, and cloud-based tracking and documentation software. Collaborate with Network Engineering on the implementation, buildout, decommissioning, and refresh of SES teleports, datacenters, and sales offices. Coordinate with system design and network operations for existing data expansion, consolidation, and relocation. Manage vendor relationships to get their equipment specs, list prices and other vendor information. Collaborate with Network Engineering on the development of floor plan layouts for datacenters and corporate offices. Develop equipment purchase orders, track orders, and arrange implementation with remote hands if not traveling for datacenter and corporate office related equipment. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 5-7 years’ hands‑on experience working in large complex network / datacenter environments specifically managing Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper and F5 hardware. Strong command of Cisco IOS, IOS‑XE, and NX‑OS, PAN‑OS, JUNOS, F5 and Linux command‑line interfaces. Advanced knowledge of Switching technologies to include, Spanning Tree (RPVST+, MST), LACP, VLANs, and Trunking. Proficient with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP, SD‑WAN) Working knowledge of F5 load balancing to include monitoring and troubleshooting load balancing VIPs, pools, and health monitors to minimize downtime and ensure seamless failover across multi‑data center environments Working knowledge of Linux Operating system to include monitoring, automation of operational tasks, and troubleshooting Linux parameters, file systems, and network stacks to maximize performance for high‑throughput applications. Working knowledge with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy Extensive experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus Hands‑on troubleshooting skills to include Wireshark packet capture debugging and analysis. In depth knowledge of security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access. Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192. Datacenter design, redundancy and failover experience a plus Racking various types of networks and server equipment. Documentation skills for datacenter, corporate office, and remote sales offices. Advanced troubleshooting skills of datacenter and office network environments. title: Fonoaudiólogo(a)
description: MISSÃO Diagnosticar, planejar, propor e executar intervenções voltadas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades de linguagem e comunicação em crianças e adolescentes com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA), atuando em equipe interdisciplinar e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e o bem‑estar dos aprendizes neurodiversos. ATIVIDADES Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar Realizar acolhimento inicial das famílias e dos clientes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta. Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, bem como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas. Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe interdisciplinar possam ter sobre nosso trabalho. Avaliação e Desenvolvimento do Plano Terapêutico Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas. Planejar e conduzir avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando protocolos específicos da área, bem como participar de avaliações interdisciplinares, sob supervisão técnica, assegurando a integração e a coerência das informações coletadas. Redigir relatórios de avaliação e elaborar planos terapêuticos individualizados junto com a equipe interdisciplinar. Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar. Intervenção Implementar o plano terapêutico individualizado, realizando a seleção, indicação e aplicação de métodos, técnicas e procedimentos terapêuticos adequados para crianças e adolescentes com TEA, com suporte da supervisão técnica. Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa. Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz. Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados. Coordenação, Monitoramento e Trabalho em Equipe Participar ativamente de reuniões e discussões com a equipe interdisciplinar, incluindo terapeutas ABA, coordenadores e supervisores. Respeitar e colaborar com profissionais de outras áreas, reconhecendo a supervisão do caso pelo supervisor ABA. Receber supervisão da fonoaudióloga sênior da clínica, implementando feedbacks para aprimorar a prática clínica. Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente. Orientar e fornecer suporte às famílias, cuidadores e, quando apropriado, à equipe escolar. ESCOLARIDADE/FORMAÇÃO Ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fonoaudiologia (CRFa). Formação em intervenção motora da fala (PROMPT, DTTC, REST) e CAA (desejável). Conhecimento em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) e TEA. Cursos complementares em Motricidade Orofacial e TEA (diferencial). EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL Experiência anterior de 6 meses na área. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Marketing Project Leader - Life Sciences
description: Descrição da empresa Ready to leverage your scientific expertise to contribute to the growth and visibility of a global leader in preclinical research? QIMA Life Sciences is looking for a Marketing Project Leader – Brazil to join our Marketing team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the B2B communication and marketing strategy targeting pharma and biotech sponsors, positioning our services as key partners in analytical and clinical development for both branded and generic drugs on the Brazilian and international markets. Scientific communication: make complex data accessible to varied audiences (sales, clients, conferences). Support the sales team: develop sales tools, training materials, and presentations. Inbound marketing: manage web pages (PT/EN), write SEO-optimized articles, produce newsletters and email campaigns, and contribute to lead generation. Measure ROI: track campaign results and lead conversions with the sales team. Event organization: coordinate participation in conferences and trade shows; build a network of KOLs and strategic partners. Qualificações MSc (or higher) in Life Sciences (Pharmacy, Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry); PhD is a plus. 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B marketing/communication within pharma, biotech, medtech, or CRO sectors. Strong understanding of the drug development process and clinical research. Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish required. Proficiency in content creation and B2B CRM tools; knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent is a plus. Strong attention to detail and regulatory awareness. Informações adicionais We Are Looking For Someone Who Is Autonomous and proactive, capable of driving a market segment. Rigorous and results-oriented, with strong organizational skills. Creative and forward-thinking. Curious about scientific and market trends. A strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills. Motivated by innovation and growth in an international environment. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Data Architect (Database Administration & Optimization)
description: You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development. Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance. Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation. Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end. Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions. Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads. Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers. Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments. Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective. Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies. Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams. Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives? Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part‑time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high‑quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally. Must be available to teach 1 or 2 hours per week on a Wednesday 1pm – 6pm AEST (Brisbane timezone). Must be available to teach in the Australian/ New Zealand timezone, we have a lot of demand for this space so hours can be flexible. Job Summary Join our global team as an online teacher for Pre‑IGCSE Science and immerse yourself in a premium one‑on‑one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student's unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you'll deliver Pre‑IGCSE Level curricula, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching. Key Responsibilities Deliver personalized, high‑quality instruction in a one‑on‑one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs. Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment. Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes. Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines. Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience. Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth. Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library. Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access. Required Qualifications A minimum of 5 years of teaching at this level in a school setting. Please note, while valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience towards this requirement. A Bachelor’s degree or higher in the subject area you will be teaching. Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team. Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods. Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A‑Levels curricula and examinations. Preferred Qualifications Teaching qualification such as postgraduate certificate in education, degree in teaching, teaching license. Online teaching experience. About Crimson Global Academy CGA is a world‑class online school delivering live, real‑time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures. We Are Doing This By Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age. Fostering a global community that broadens students' perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage. Providing cutting‑edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child’s education. If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one‑on‑one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning, apply now! To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineerto join theInvestments Business Unit. Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements. About Nubank's Engineering Culture: We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on. Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products. What we have to offer: Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets. Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments. Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns. Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms. Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms. Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations). Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For) 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.). Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams. Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy. Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops. Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers. Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals. Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives. Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape. Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs. AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way. Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense. Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level. If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you! #J-18808-Ljbffr

A/B Testing Support: Assist in conducting A/B tests for copy and strategies, tracking data performance, and providing insights for future optimization. Logic & Copywriting: Excellent writing skills with the ability to capture user psychology; strong logical thinking and a basic understanding of user segmentation. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do. We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other. Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow. Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. description: Overview Senior Staff Software Engineer - Debt Resolution About Nubank Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 123 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. About the role We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to help lead the architectural direction of Nubank’s Global Debt Resolution platform, operating horizontally across all business areas. You will align the debt resolution stack to a cohesive long-term technical vision spanning Lending, Credit Card, and Credit Platform (Core Banking), ensuring we build globally scalable, compliant, and reusable solutions. This is a high‑influence IC leadership role where you will shape both the platform and the teams that build on top of it. You will identify the right long‑term patterns for collections, renegotiations, and payments, and push them consistently across all business areas and credit domains. By sitting at the intersection of Lending, Credit Card, and Credit Platform, you will ensure every new initiative builds toward a unified, multi‑market debt resolution platform. Mission Design and operationalize a horizontal technical strategy for Global Debt Resolution so that: Legacy vs. Future is Deliberate: The boundaries between legacy, stable, and future systems are explicit, with clear migration plans and guardrails that reduce long‑term complexity and risk. Cross‑BU Leverage is Maximized: High‑leverage capabilities (e.g., renegotiation, late‑state flows, payment allocation, credit core integrations) are built once and reused across Debt Resolution, Lending, Credit Card, and Core Banking, instead of re‑implemented in silos. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR). Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. title: FONOAUDIOLOGO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL CARDOSO FONTES
description: Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes . OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia. Atender pacientes para prevenção, habilitação e reabilitação da saúde, utilizando protocolos e procedimentos específicos de fonoaudiologia; Tratar pacientes e clientes; Efetuar avaliação e diagnóstico fonoaudiológico; Realizar triagem auditiva neonatal (Emissões Otoacústicas); Realizar o teste da linguinha; Executar atendimento de Motricidade Orofacial ao recém-nascido; Realizar rotina de promoção e incentivo do Aleitamento Materno; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Ensino Superior Completo em Fonoaudiologia Pós-Graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Audiologia, Linguagem, Motricidade Orofacial, Saúde Coletiva, Disfagia, Fonoaudiologia Neurofuncional, Gerontologia ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Fonoaudiólogo. Local de Trabalho: Jacarepaguá/RJ Carga Horária: 30H (diurno e noturno) e 40H (diarista) A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos , bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Inclusão A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental. SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Nosso foco principal é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus, peças genuínas e manutenção especializada. Estamos presentes em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados pelas operações: Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação. No agronegócio , pelas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do MT, Sul de MG e região de Campinas/SP), atuamos na criação, recria e engorda de bovinos e na produção de café, soja e milho, sempre com foco em sustentabilidade e preservação ambiental. Nossa holding está no Rio de Janeiro e contamos com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. title: Mecânico Diesel

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a logística e a forma de fazer entregas no Brasil. Queremos empoderar pessoas e transformar negócios com entregas de excelência. Movimentamos mais de 500 mil pacotes por dia com uma tecnologia de ponta a ponta, que aproxima todos os cantos do país. Temos o propósito de que as entregas sejam acessíveis para todas as pessoas do Brasil. Esse é nosso desafio diário, por isso, buscamos inovação em tudo que fazemos. Por aqui, valorizamos diferentes formas de pensar, pois sabemos que só assim podemos criar o futuro. Nossa cultura é traduzida todos os dias pelos comportamentos de cada Logger e das experiências que construímos com os nossos clientes e sociedade. Possuímos como missão conectar as cidades brasileiras por meio de uma logística eficiente, baseada em tecnologia própria e que garanta que os pacotes cheguem até o destino final, transformando sonhos em realidades. title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description: · Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university. · Hold a current valid medical license. · Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required. · Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups. · Fluency in English. Reports to: Spa Manager Job Summary The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to on onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures, safely and effectively, and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services, to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions, safely and effectively, to address the concerns of on board guests. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi–Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi-Spa Physicians if necessary. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to gain the knowledge of the spa services and products in effort to cross-promote these services to guests. The Medi-Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi – Spa Sales Consultant. Position requirements Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests Work closely with the Medi–Spa Sales Consultant Must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills Must be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi-spa services Enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality Excellent communication and listening skills Basic computer knowledge Must be a team player Duties and Responsibilities · Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment. · Provide consistent professional medi-spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld’s medi-spa protocols. · Conduct patient follow-up as required. · Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest. · Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control . · Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld. · Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager’s office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years. (3 years on Cunard and P&O). · Cross-promote other spa services. · Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure. · Properly clean and restock medi-spa treatment room as required. · Manage medical product and supply inventory. · Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention. · Handle guests’ questions and concerns professionally and courteously. · Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests. · Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment. · Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa. · Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings. · Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management. · Train new spa staff in medi-spa services/cross-promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions. · Follow Medi-Spa Operations Policies. · Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report. General Guidelines · For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service. · All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms. Doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest. · At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy. · Conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them. Schedule a follow-up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk. · Clean your room and set up for your next guest. · Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest. This means the room must be: · Clean – sanitize work surfaces and sink area; store trash is proper receptacles. · (biohazard/sharps/trash); All trash must be taken out daily or when full. · Organized –stock boxes should be out of sight and all supplies must be organized or stored properly . · Inviting – the treatment bed must be properly dressed and proper ambience with regards to music and temperature. End of Day Checklist · Dispose of open unused needles · Dispose of Bio-Hazard bag if full · Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full · Sterilize table and countertops · Fill out inventory control form · Email daily revenue report to shore side team Service booking policy A clean, non-intimidating, state-of-the-art and stress-free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. A critical element to the success of our spa is our ability to work together as a team. If we are unable to work seamlessly together, our guest will be the first to notice. It will not only hurt the business of our spa but will affect your individual success in this industry. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention: · Medi-Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer. · In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services if you are not qualified to perform all services. · Medi-Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager’s approval. title: TÉCNICO DE REFRIGERAÇÃO
description: GUARACAMP! Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca. Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca. Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência. Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado. Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito. Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência. E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos. A Guaracamp disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99. OBJETIVO DO CARGO Garantir o funcionamento eficiente e contínuo dos sistemas de refrigeração e climatização por meio da execução de manutenções preventivas e corretivas, assegurando o conforto térmico e a integridade dos equipamentos, alinhado às normas de segurança e sustentabilidade. Executar testes, lubrificação e ajustes para garantir o funcionamento adequado dos sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado. Montar e instalar tubulações de refrigeração, dutos e ramais para climatização. Realizar procedimentos de carga e recarga de fluido refrigerante, seguindo normas técnicas e ambientais. Identificar e corrigir vazamentos e falhas em sistemas de refrigeração. Calcular carga térmica para dimensionar equipamentos e sistemas de climatização. Aplicar vácuo em sistemas de refrigeração e assegurar a correta vedação dos componentes. Especificar e requisitar materiais, peças e acessórios necessários para manutenção e instalação. Realizar testes operacionais nos equipamentos após manutenção ou instalação para garantir sua eficiência. Assegurar a limpeza e conservação das ferramentas, equipamentos e área de trabalho após a execução dos serviços. Cumprir normas de segurança e procedimentos ambientais durante as atividades de manutenção. Acompanhar fornecedores externos em processos de instalação e manutenção de sistemas de refrigeração e climatização. PRÉ REQUISITOS Nível técnico completo em Refrigeração, Climatização, Mecânica de Refrigeração ou áreas correlatas. Experiência mínima de 2 anos na manutenção de sistemas de refrigeração e climatização. Experiência com instalação e reparo de equipamentos de ar-condicionado, sistemas de ventilação e câmaras frias. Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos e realizar plantões. NR 35 - Trabalho em altura. CNH Categoria B. Proatividade e senso de dono. Visão sistêmica e capacidade de negociação. Facilidade para trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders. Buscamos alguém que tenha experiência em...
